race.comment: JUST MY LOT (13) is racing very well this time in, winning her maiden effortlessly by over 5 lengths at Hamilton two back then going close over this route on heavy ground last time. She can continue to improve and will roll forward again with Meech booked. BOTH SIDES NOW (7) presents fourth up and might be ready to show something up on speed, she was better here last time and her best is good enough. EN FLIQUE (2) struggled fresh in tougher grade but is better placed here, expect she comes on plenty from that. GARNACHO (3) was solid fresh at Bendigo and is suited up in trip now, he should be thereabouts.
